{{Top|leg|title=''Quest for Quasar'' spin-off source}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
This non-canon '''spin-off source''' of the original ''[[Quest for Quasar]]'' stated that one of the characters, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Baltharog]], was 1.89 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. ''Quest for Quasar'' fan [[Groz Niclari]], who went by the nickname "QuasarKing327," collected almost 1.5 million signatures on a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] petition to have 1.84-meter-tall actor [[Harlan Ottekvar]] replaced in [[Myris Pictures]]{{'s}} [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilm]] adaption of ''Quest for Quasar''. Some fans pointed out that Baltharog's height came from this source and was therefore not canon.
